Text-reuse data computed by DharmaNexus demonstrates extensive Pali-internal connections with the commentary tradition and other canonical verse texts [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records low-scoring automatic alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Suvarṇaprabhāsottamasūtra*, though these are computational text-reuse matches rather than established canonical parallels [DharmaNexus].
